purpose: Uniquely materialize the structural 500-node stress oracle and its semantic distributions without committing renderer or layout runtime code.

status.note: The recipe and expected oracles are declarative until a committed materializer and semantic validator execute them.

recipeFingerprintAlgorithm.input: materialization object with its recipeFingerprint member omitted

layout.canonicalPositionFormula: globalOrdinal is domainOrdinal or 10 plus competencyOrdinal; x=((globalOrdinal-1)%10)*340; y=floor((globalOrdinal-1)/10)*180
layout.personalEffectivePositionFormula: canonical x plus 40 and y plus 24
layout.personalOverrideOwnership: overrideWorkspaceId and overrideRevision equal the fixture workspace constants

stateBuckets.summaryText: Unknown because no qualifying evidence is available.
Known STALE estimate with LOW confidence.
Known WEAK estimate with LOW confidence.
Known STRONG estimate with MEDIUM confidence.

nodeRecipe.originRule: All domains and competency ordinals 1..465 are CANONICAL; 466..490 are accepted WORKSPACE_OVERLAY content in the fixture workspace.
nodeRecipe.requirementStateRule: Build sorted direct ruleIds from rule leaf membership. Unknown required leaves use interval 0..1. Known VERIFIED leaves use 1; known STALE leaves use 0.5333333333; other known leaves use 0.67. A direct mandatory-floor leaf uses UNKNOWN or BELOW, otherwise NOT_APPLICABLE.
nodeRecipe.visibilityRule: Domains use DOMAIN,GROUP,COMPETENCY and STRUCTURAL_CONTEXT. Competencies use COMPETENCY,SELECTED_ACTIVITY and PERSONAL_OVERLAY, REQUIRED_BY_TARGET, or STRUCTURAL_CONTEXT by that precedence.
nodeRecipe.explanationRule: Each node has one state.{lowercaseBucket} explanation whose message equals summaryText and whose references are the node plus its sorted direct ruleIds.

families.originRule: WORKSPACE_OVERLAY when source ordinal is 465..489 because either endpoint is personal; CANONICAL otherwise.

textTemplates.partOfRationale: Stress competency {sourceDddd} belongs to stress domain {domainDddd} for navigation.
textTemplates.partOfAccessibility: Stress competency {sourceDddd} is part of stress domain {domainDddd}.
textTemplates.prerequisiteAccessibility: Stress competency {sourceDddd} is a prerequisite of stress competency {targetDddd}.
textTemplates.relatedRationale: Deterministic non-blocking related context from {sourceDddd} to {targetDddd}.
textTemplates.relatedAccessibility: Stress competency {sourceDddd} is related to stress competency {targetDddd}.
textTemplates.userAddedRationale: Accepted personal non-blocking context from {sourceDddd} to {targetDddd}.
textTemplates.userAddedAccessibility: Personal stress competency {sourceDddd} is related to stress competency {targetDddd}.

edgeRecipe.prerequisiteDagProof: Every prerequisite target ordinal is greater than its source ordinal.

construction: 0001 ALL references rules 0002..0005 and is root.
0004 WEIGHTED_THRESHOLD 0.8 references rules 0016..0020 at weight 0.2 each.
0006..0010 are MANDATORY_FLOOR rules for competency ordinals 1..5 at APPLICATION VERIFIED.
0011..0015 are ANY rules over consecutive triples of competency ordinals 6..20 at KNOWLEDGE COMPLETED.
0016..0020 are K_OF_N rules requiring 2 of consecutive triples of competency ordinals 21..35 at APPLICATION COMPLETED.
0021..0024 are WEIGHTED_THRESHOLD 0.75 rules over consecutive groups of five competency ordinals 36..55 at weight 0.2 and RECALL VERIFIED.
0025 is a MANDATORY_FLOOR for competency ordinal 56 at APPLICATION VERIFIED.

readinessRecipe.unknownNodeSelection: All nodes whose global state ordinal is 1..50, sorted by nodeId.
readinessRecipe.staleNodeSelection: All nodes whose global state ordinal is 51..125, sorted by nodeId.
readinessRecipe.domainBreakdownRule: Ten domain rows in domain-node ID order, each with interval 0.15..0.87, coverage 0.29, confidence LOW.

explanations.message: Stress competency 0056 is known stale and below its verified mandatory floor.
Forty required competencies remain unknown and are represented as intervals, not zero.

readinessRecipe.displayLabel: Readiness 15 to 87 out of 100, confidence Low, status Not ready.

outlineRecipe.domainItems: Ten roots. sortKey is {domainOrdinal*100 as dddd}:stress-{domainDddd}. childItemIds are competencies d,d+10,...,d+480 sorted by outlineItemId.
outlineRecipe.competencyItems: Parent is domainForCompetency. depth 1. sortKey is {1000+competencyOrdinal as dddd}:stress-{competencyDddd}. No children.

visibilityRecipe.selectionRule: Select all ten domain nodes plus competency ordinals 1..140, then sort those 150 node IDs. From all edges whose two endpoints are selected, take the first 299 sorted edge IDs.
visibilityRecipe.perItemFlagRule: Set node or edge visibilityHint.defaultVisible true exactly when its ID is present in the corresponding default-visible list; false otherwise.

materialization.serializationRecipe: Construct properties in GraphProjectionV1 schema order and sort every identity array by the declared comparator. Exact expanded-byte hashing is intentionally deferred until a committed test materializer exists.

scopeNote: This descriptor is a design scaffold. JSON parsing and the recipe fingerprint can be checked now, but expanded schema/semantic validation, exact expanded-byte hashing, runtime p95, and frame budgets remain for a later committed test materializer and renderer/layout implementation. This task adds no generator dependency, React Flow, or Dagre runtime.
